title: SSO setup
text: Acme Cloud supports SAML SSO on the Business and Enterprise plans. Admins upload identity-provider metadata in Settings > Security.
answer: Acme Cloud supports SAML SSO on Business and Enterprise plans. Admins configure it by uploading identity-provider metadata in Settings > Security.

title: Data exports
text: Workspace exports include tickets, comments, and audit events. Exports are available as CSV files and stay downloadable for seven days.
answer: Workspace exports include tickets, comments, and audit events as CSV files. The files stay downloadable for seven days.

title: Retention controls
text: Enterprise customers can set custom retention from 30 to 365 days. Shorter retention deletes resolved tickets and associated comments after the chosen window.
answer: Enterprise customers can set retention from 30 to 365 days. Shorter retention deletes resolved tickets and associated comments after that window.

title: Webhook retries
text: Webhook delivery retries use exponential backoff for up to six hours. Failed deliveries appear in the integration log with the last response code.
answer: Webhook delivery retries use exponential backoff for up to six hours. Failed deliveries appear in the integration log with the last response code.
